subject: Insurance
title: The Insurtech Funding Boom
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Insurtech Funding Boom.

hook.text: Insurtech startups raised $15.4 billion in 2021 alone.

buildup.text: Hundreds of startups tackled every segment: home, auto, health, pet, travel, and cyber insurance.

twist.text: Insurance is a regulated, capital-intensive business.

climax.text: The insurtech boom shows that disruption requires both technology and underwriting discipline.

quiz.question: Why have many insurtech startups struggled despite heavy funding?
options: Insurance requires regulated capital reserves and underwriting discipline, not just technology
